project_info.color_palette: Pastel lilac, pink, mint, pale yellow, holographic rainbow, white

main_subject.detail: One young woman appears repeatedly in a colorful Y2K scrapbook collage, with a central full-body cutout and supporting close-up, camera, bubblegum, cat, daisy, and peace-sign poses; she wears a pastel striped cropped sweater, pink mini skirt, striped socks, white sneakers, and floral hair clips.
main_subject.style: Hyperreal early-2000s magazine cutout collage with stickers, neon outlines, glitter, and soft flash

items: Center: full-body standing woman with hand on hip and lens-flare keychain.
Top left: close-up portrait inside tilted Polaroid frame.
Top right: crouching pose holding white camera.
Middle and lower panels: bubblegum pose, cat portrait, seated peace sign, daisy bouquet.
All around: holographic stars, hearts, butterflies, sparkles, doodle lines, pastel panels and cutout borders.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Cinematic neon Y2K color grading, glossy skin finish, dreamy retro glow, balanced intentional chaos

prompt_instructions: Attach identity reference only with consent or a licensed fictional character asset.
Maintain one consistent identity through every cutout; do not blend faces.
Keep the Y2K styling intentionally maximal but compositionally balanced.
